newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks firm in early trade on US stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks firm in early trade on US stock rise.

text.p: Tokyo stocks firmed in early Friday morning trade following yet another record high posted by the Dow industrials overnight, brokers said. They said however that activity was likely to be slow ahead of the weekend and also the end of the trading month.
As of 0023 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 92.01 points or 0.45 percent at 20,378.24. Its September futures were up 90 at 20,420.
"There are no decisive factors to lead trade, but investors are hunting for smaller stocks with good earnings, rather than big-name issues," one broker said.
